scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Claims of method-level zero absolute-monotonicity radius and of eight-state unrestricted counterexamples are attributed to the prior literature, not presented as new.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.originality_risk: A differently formulated or unindexed exact cycle characterization may exist. Independent expert originality audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact real end-step Padé matrix of a simple unit-rate undirected cycle. For sizes at least seven, only local-in-step small/large regimes are classified. The six-cycle full threshold and large-step asymptotic signs are exact.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.verification: Analytic graph-distance, circulant and spectral pseudoinverse arguments. A standalone SymPy program reproduces 438 algebraic assertions; finite tests do not replace the all-size proof.

title: Sharp six- and fourteen-site positivity transitions for fourth-order Gauss steps on cycles
